items.claim: A domain trust relationship is the prerequisite that lets the same reconnaissance queries be re-pointed at the partner domain, exposing its domain controllers, enterprise admin group, Kerberos policy and local groups without a second foothold.
items.body:
A domain trust relationship is the prerequisite that lets the same reconnaissance queries be re-pointed at the partner domain, exposing its domain controllers, enterprise admin group, Kerberos policy and local groups without a second foothold.

HackTricks reference: 24bbaae1 (notion:24bbaae1-83f6-4d5b-b46f-56873b57ee01)
items.disproof: The same queries against the partner domain return no data or access denied, showing no usable trust relationship is in place.

items.claim: The AD trust objects and the full set of domains in the current forest are directly enumerable, giving a hunter the exact map of which domains and trust partners a compromised domain can reach.
items.body:
The AD trust objects and the full set of domains in the current forest are directly enumerable, giving a hunter the exact map of which domains and trust partners a compromised domain can reach.

HackTricks reference: 23831a60 (notion:23831a60-ba8b-4540-bc80-7de8762c1080)
items.disproof: The trust and forest queries return no entries or are denied, so no cross-domain reach is available from the current domain.
